name: slice
title: Slice the picture
description: Turn the picture into the Region map: key-background and vectorize, about 3 to 5 s, no stitches yet. Returns the result of every stitch type override (applied, refused with its coverage %, orphaned, shadowed). Settings left out keep their last value.

size_mm.description: Patch size in mm; null fills the hoop.

overrides.description: Stitch type overrides, each a point in source picture pixels (x right, y down) and the stitch type for the Region holding it. Replaces the current list; [] clears it.

name: make_stitch_plan
title: Make the stitch plan
description: Export the last Slice to VP3 through Ink/Stitch and render the Stitch plan. About 10 s on a warm cache, up to many minutes cold. Waits up to wait_s seconds (default 60); when the export still runs, call status later.

name: status
title: Job status
description: The current job: state (idle, slicing, exporting, failed, cancelled), stage, elapsed time, the last Slice with its override results, and the Stitch plan (stitches, size, threads, warnings) when one exists.

name: cancel
title: Cancel the running job
description: Stop the running Slice or export and every process it started.
